messages:
Anya: Customer legal requires EU-only inference for EU tenants. Need strict routing + variant handling.
Tom: So no cross-region fallback at all?
Anya: Correct. If EU-variant missing, reject and surface how to request a mirror.
Chris: We need a catalog-driven compatibility matrix to allow same-region compatible variants (e.g., p6q-eu-int8 vs p6q-eu-int4) with a compat score.
Maria: Add response header X-Model-Status: ok|compat|missing|unknown and X-Compat-Score when compat. Also metric variant_missing{tenant,model,region}.
Tom: Proxy behavior: check local catalog cache; if unknown -> 412 variant-unknown. If missing -> 409 variant-missing + link to mirror request. No auto-fetch from other regions.
Chris: Allow operator-triggered mirror flow and a small CLI endpoint for customers to request EU mirroring. Until mirror completes, requests must fail.
Maria: Canary note: support X-Canary-Model header for whitelisted tenants only, still enforcing region artifact presence.
Anya: Action items: Tom -> routing PR with codes; Chris -> catalog schema for compat matrix; Maria -> headers/metrics. deploy-bot: create ticket for signed-manifest publish.
deploy-bot: created INF-2389: "signed-manifest + regional-artifact-mirroring"
